source: Fujimi press release: Notice Concerning the Formulation of the Medium- to (10-09-2026)

quarterly_data.signal: Fujimi finalized the quantitative targets of its new Medium- to Long-Term Business Plan 2026 (fiscal years ending March 2027 through March 2032), formulated in light of the recent acceleration in the growth of the semiconductor market; it replaces the 2023 plan, which targeted net sales of JPY 95.0 billion in FY2029. Targets for FY2027 / FY2029 / FY2032: net sales JPY 82.5 / 104.0 / 138.0 billion; operating income margin 20.9% / 20% / 21%; EBITDA margin 26.0% / 29% / 31%; ROE 14.3% / 14% / 17%. Net sales by application (JPY billions, FY2027 / FY2029 / FY2032): CMP 46.1 / 61.5 / 85.8; Silicon 23.8 / 27.6 / 31.8; Hard Disk 2.6 / 2.3 / 2.1; General Industry abrasive 6.8 / 7.9 / 9.6 and non-abrasive 3.2 / 4.7 / 4.7; M&A 4.0 in FY2032. The company aims to evolve from an abrasives manufacturer into a 'Powder & Surface Company'; further details of the plan will be announced in November 2026.
quarterly_data.figure: FY2032 targets: net sales JPY 138.0 billion (CMP JPY 85.8 billion), operating income margin 21%, EBITDA margin 31%, ROE 17%; FY2029 net sales JPY 104.0 billion
quarterly_data.quarter: Fujimi press release: Notice Concerning the Formulation of the Medium- to (10-09-2026)

quarterly_data.signal: Investment plan (Medium- to Long-Term Business Plan 2026): Fujimi states demand for advanced logic semiconductors for AI and advanced memory including high-bandwidth memory (HBM) has been increasing, prompting device makers to expand capacity, and that its production facilities are already operating at high utilization rates, so further capacity expansion is essential to meet growing customer demand. It plans cumulative capital expenditure of JPY 130 billion over FY2027-FY2032 (FY2027 plan JPY 19.0 billion; JPY 85.0 billion over FY2027-FY2029 and JPY 45.0 billion over FY2030-FY2032), against JPY 30.0 billion over FY2024-FY2026 in the previous plan. Major planned investments: expansion of the Kakamiyama Plant in Gifu (originally completed in February 2026), a new plant on adjacent land already acquired, and a second plant for its Taiwan subsidiary (site selection underway) - final investment decisions not yet made; a new R&D center scheduled for completion by the end of 2026; plus M&A investments for new businesses.
quarterly_data.figure: capex JPY 130 billion cumulative FY2027-FY2032 (FY2027 plan JPY 19.0 billion); facilities at high utilization
